---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new control, sensor, mapping, or workflow
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Use case

Describe the situation, not the solution. _"I want to control X while doing Y"_ is better than _"add Z to the codebase"_.

## Proposed behavior

How should it work once it's built? What does the user press / move / see?

## Current alternatives

What do you use today as a workaround? (Existing mobile controller, TouchOSC template, mouse mapping, etc.)

## Is it tiny, or does it deserve its own release?

- Small: can ship in a patch (v0.4.X).
- Medium: a minor version (v0.5.0).
- Big: needs a roadmap discussion before it touches the codebase.

I think this is: ___

## Out of scope?

Anything you explicitly do NOT want (to avoid scope creep)?
